stories.title: Crew conditions on deployed carrier become political flashpoint
new_facts: Treasury Secretary Bessent announced unprecedented economic isolation of Iran and continued Strait of Hormuz blockade.
Sen. Richard Blumenthal named as demanding answers; Lincoln has not come ashore in over 200 days, a record.
Senate Democrats specifically (not just unnamed congressional lawmakers) are demanding answers about Lincoln conditions.
USS Abraham Lincoln is now set to head home from the Middle East, per a U.S. official.
Wife of sailor who went overboard is now speaking out with disturbing details about the incident.
stories.line: An aircraft carrier deployed for 250+ days faces reported crew hardship; Pentagon disputes severity as Democrats seek answers.

stories.title: Chinese tech valuations surge past U.S. peers amid AI boom
new_facts: Star 50 index up 29% this year; Chinese tech valuations at multiples of US peers, backed by Beijing.
Global companies including Apple and Ford increasingly adopting Chinese technology despite geopolitical risks.
stories.line: Chinese tech companies are trading at higher valuations than U.S. counterparts as AI investment accelerates globally.

stories.title: Transplant recipient engaged to donor's brother
stories.line: A woman who received a liver transplant years ago is now engaged to marry her donor's brother.

stories.title: Flock Safety adds oversight after police misuse of surveillance cameras
new_facts: Over 120,000 Flock ALPR cameras installed across the US; cameras track vehicles via AI.
Previously optional safeguards will become mandatory for all users by Jan. 1.
20 billion license plate scans per month; system misused to target immigrants and abortion seekers; safety measures were previously optional and many agencies did not enable them.
stories.line: Flock Safety, an automatic license-plate camera company, faces pressure over police misuse of its surveillance network and is proposing new oversight measures.

stories.title: A-level results reach record highs as gender gap widens at top grades
stories.line: A-level results hit record highs with 25% earning top grades; boys outpaced girls at highest achievement levels.

stories.title: Iran and US escalate Strait of Hormuz standoff as vessel attacks mount
new_facts: UAE accuses Iran of attacking two ADNOC vessels in the Strait of Hormuz, calling it piracy.
stories.line: Iran and the US both claim control of the Strait of Hormuz as tensions escalate over vessel attacks and economic pressure.

stories.title: Kennedy Center board votes to restore Trump's name to building
new_facts: Board also renamed the surrounding area 'President Donald J. Trump Plaza'.
Federal judge named: U.S. District Judge Christopher Cooper; his May ruling called board decision 'ill-informed and seemingly preordained'.
Kennedy Center board voted to add Trump's name to facade, circumventing judge's removal order, potentially setting new legal fight.
Inscription would read 'Restored and Renovated by President Donald [Trump]', placed beneath existing Kennedy Center signage; board also voted partial closure for two-year overhaul.
stories.line: Kennedy Center board votes to inscribe Trump's name on the building's facade, reversing a 2021 decision to remove it.

stories.title: Judge threatens contempt charges over Trump DOJ's handling of Epstein files
new_facts: Federal judge warns Trump DOJ of contempt over withheld/unredacted Epstein files at public hearing.
stories.line: A judge is demanding the Trump DOJ explain why it redacted Epstein files and withheld materials, threatening contempt charges.

stories.title: Kushner and Iger buy Lakers; Ohtani's status with Dodgers in question
new_facts: Walter's federal investigation involves alleged loan fraud; speculation Dodgers could be sold after Lakers deal.
stories.line: Josh Kushner and Bob Iger buy the Lakers; Shohei Ohtani's future with the Dodgers becomes uncertain if Mark Walter sells.

stories.title: Romania closes last nuclear reactor as Danube drought worsens
new_facts: Both reactors now shut (last working reactor offline); Moldova affected as it relies on Romanian power.
Hungary racing to dam the Danube to keep its Paks nuclear plant online.
stories.line: Romania shut its last nuclear reactor amid drought; the Danube has dropped to record lows, straining power generation across the region.
